ops.text: 2.11 Affiliates and Contractors. All licenses granted to Corio under this Section 2 extend to Corio's affiliates (any entity controlling, controlled by or under common control with Corio) and to contractors acting on Corio's behalf, provided that Corio remains responsible for their compliance with the terms of this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short subsection extending the Section 2 licenses to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, with us remaining responsible for their compliance, since our playbook requires the grant to reach affiliates and contractors. If preferred, we can instead limit this to affiliates identified by written notice to Commerce One.
input.summary: Extend Section 2 licences to Corio's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf.
